prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0004",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 0,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01027-01027",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺はハイシェラを腰に差すと改めて部屋を見渡した。",
      "en": "I sheathed Haishera at my hip and looked around the room once more."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01034-01035",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（ふむ、辺境の街にしては良い部屋だの）",
      "en": "(Hmm, for a frontier town, this is a fine room.)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01037-01041",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺の目を通して部屋の様子を見たハイシェラが、\n珍しく讃辞の言葉を漏らす。\nもっとも、今回の旅の様にシュリが供に付いていない場合に\n俺が泊まる安宿に比べればと言う事なのだろうが……。",
      "en": "Haishera, seeing the room through my eyes, uncharacteristically offered praise. Though that was likely only compared to the cheap inns I stay at when Shuri is not with me, like on this trip..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01043-01044",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ、いい部屋だな",
      "en": "Yeah, it is a nice room."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01050-01051",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ふふっ、ありがと",
      "en": "Hehe, thanks."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01053-01055",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ハイシェラに答えるつもりだったが、うっかりと\n声に出して呟いた俺に、換えのシーツを手にしたリンシャが\n戸口から微笑んでいた。",
      "en": "I had meant to answer Haishera, but I inadvertently spoke aloud. Rinsha, holding fresh sheets, smiled at me from the doorway."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01057-01059",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "さぁ、荷物を置いたらシュリちゃんを誘って\n下の食堂に行って、お腹空いてるでしょ？",
      "en": "Come on, put your things down and bring Shuri\nto the dining room downstairs. You're hungry, right?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01061-01062",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "言われるまで気にしていなかったが、そう言えば\nこの街に着いてからまだ何も口にしていない。",
      "en": "I hadn't noticed until she mentioned it, but come to think of it, I haven't eaten anything since arriving in this town."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01064-01065",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "いいのか？",
      "en": "Is that all right?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01067-01068",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "大丈夫、ちゃんと付けにしておくから",
      "en": "It's fine, I'll put it on your tab."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01070-01070",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言ってリンシャは胸元から先程の宝石を取り出して見せた。",
      "en": "So saying, she took the gem from her bosom."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01076-01085",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺とリンシャは二階にある部屋から連れ立って階段を\n降りて来た。\nあの後、誘うまでもなく俺の部屋に様子を見に来たシュリが\nリンシャの手にしたシーツを見ると、\n部屋の掃除やベッドメイクは自分がやると申し出た。\n最初は悪いと言って遠慮したリンシャだったが、\nシュリの懇願する様な態度に圧倒され、\nその申し出を承諾したのだ。",
      "en": "Rinsha and I came down the stairs from the second floor. After that, Shuri checked on my room uninvited. She saw the sheets Rinsha was holding and offered to clean the room and make the bed herself. Rinsha initially declined, saying it was too much, but Shuri's pleading look convinced her to agree."
    }
  ]
}
